title: engine + driver-sql: seven filter-refusal doors ignore the #8220 provenance mark, so a refusal inside a `policy` read-scope subtree relays the policy field (and some comparands) in its 400: the #7929 redaction is not applied
body:
Filing gate ① — a product defect with named sites and a measurement (class b: a declared, ruled contract not held at some of the doors it names).

- **Filed by:** the `domain:services` seat (`session_01Evb5jFDZGKQE9KG4jbMfMF`, seat post #6021).
- **Surfaced by:** the #19995 dev on PR #20017, whose residue this is.
- ⛔ This is not a claim.
- **Actionable reader:** the lane that owns `packages/objectql` and `packages/drivers/driver-sql` (triage routes). #19995 waits on this card.

## The contract (standing ruling, not a new decision)

`packages/spec/src/data/filter-subtree-provenance.ts` (#8220, which implements A of the #7929 maintainer ruling of 2026-08-12, 「接受你的全部建议。」):

- `'policy'`: 「injected policy the caller never wrote (an RLS / sharing / tenant read scope). A refusal raised from inside it keeps the #7929 redaction: identity (`INVALID_FILTER` / 400) and capability statement on the wire, operands in the server log.」
- 「**Unmarked or ambiguous ⇒ withheld.**」 The header names the two read-scope merge boundaries that stamp the mark: `plugin-security`'s CRUD injection and `service-analytics`' `ObjectQLStrategy.withReadScope`.

## The defect

Only `driver-sql`'s bind and cross-field refusals read the mark. Seven refusal classes raised from inside a `'policy'`-marked read scope do not, and their 400 message names the policy's field, and for some classes its comparand:

| refusal class | refusing door |
|:--|:--|
| a column the object does not have | `driver-sql` (missing column) |
| a retired or unknown operator | `driver-sql` operator vocabulary |
| a text operator on a non-text field | engine declared-type door |
| a temporal comparand the platform cannot read | engine temporal door |
| a combinator with a non-array operand | `driver-sql` |
| a non-boolean `$null` / `$exists` | `driver-sql` |
| an unknown filter placeholder | engine token resolver (`FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN`) |

## Measured (the #19995 dev; ⛔ not re-run by this seat)

- **Setup:** real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3) and `SqliteWasmDriver`, both drivers identical. The HTTP legs went through the real `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` and `POST /analytics/dataset/query` routes.
- **Result:** every class above answered a 400 whose body carried the policy's field, on both doors. The table and the probe are in the `os-dev-report` on #19995 and in PR #20017's body.
- **Already closed, not this card:** PR #20017 moves the nine shape classes the engine's two shared comparand faces refuse to `READ_SCOPE_COMPILE_FAILED` / 500 on the analytics face. Those are judged analytics-side before the merge.
- **Reachability:** a policy naming a column that was renamed or removed (schema drift), and admin-authored CEL comparisons on date or number fields.
- **Not measured:** whether the same doors also relay policy content on the ordinary CRUD face (`plugin-security`'s merge). Measure that first.

## Direction (per the ruling; the implementer measures)

- Each door above resolves the mark of the offending node (`resolveFilterSubtreeProvenance`) and discloses its full diagnostic only for a subtree positively marked `'author'`. `'policy'` and unmarked keep `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 with the operands in the server log only, which is the #7929 B shape `driver-sql`'s cross-field refusal already has.
- ⚠️ Unmarked ⇒ withheld also reaches a caller's own filter on a host that stamps no mark. Measure which hosts stamp before choosing.
- Envelope note, for the record: on the analytics face this gives the residue a withheld 400 (#8220), while the analytics read-scope compiler's own refusals are a withheld 500 (#5367). Both rulings withhold the policy content. This card does not decide the status split.

## Dedupe

One semantic issue search, open and closed, on 「driver-sql or engine filter refusal does not consult filter subtree provenance mark policy; missing column unknown operator refusal message discloses RLS policy field in 400」: 75 hits. Adjacent: #19995 (the analytics face; its residue is this card), #19949 (driver-mongodb cross-field), and #19885 (closed). None covers mark-blind refusal doors.
